text: Free demo: a whole shopping mall is a total mess, and you tidy it.
Over thirty thousand items, across six stores. Toys, books, wine, games.
No timer, no pressure. Just turning chaos into perfect shelves.
Best part: look at a shelf and dozens of items fly off the floor and snap into place.
The catch? The item labels on the floor look like debug text.
The demo is about two point seven gigs, in fourteen languages, and the full game is out September eighteenth.
Think Unpacking, meets House Flipper, in a mall.
Worth a dip if mess makes you itchy.
